topic: ML Traffic prediction job review and scheduling
summary_markdown:
A Pull Request (PR) for an ML Traffic prediction job was reviewed. The PR structure and the associated Rundeck job were approved, though minor improvements to sample vendor parameters were suggested.

Discussion shifted to future development: implementing a single-button process in Rundeck to recalculate data specifically for one company on a specific dataset.

The deployment schedule was debated, with initial suggestions of merging immediately or over the weekend. The final decision was made to merge the changes on Monday to allow time for fixing potential issues before client viewing during the work week.
decisions: The ML Traffic prediction PR and job are approved pending minor parameter improvements.
The main code merge will occur on Monday.
action_items: Develop a single-button Rundeck process for company-specific data recalculation.
